I sent Hollis a reply in his DM. Each issue has a ticket number, but I couldn't find the current status of either one.

- **Salina North Gatehouse Check-In report timeout: ticket #4409.** It's a recurring timeout at Bay 4 and the west grain-bin apron during the 06:00 flatbed intake. The source is Moss's "Central handoffs" digest from 2 Jan 2026. It lists #4409 as one of two open tickets Hollis flagged on "Pree's dealer account" before Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan. The other was #4412, a driver SMS glitch when staging combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots. I found nothing later on #4409.
- **West yard Door 2 double-booking: ticket #8841.** On 13 Oct in #central-random, Tobias told Hollis that Door 2 still double-books when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. He said he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Nobody has posted about it since.

Neither source actually names Marrow Fieldworks. One says "Pree's dealer account" and the other "Tobias's dealer account," so I'm assuming that's the same account before and after the January handoff. I told Hollis to check with Tobias if he needs that confirmed. There are no account ticket or CRM files in the share that I can see.

I only used sources Hollis can see himself: #central-team, #central-random, public files and the knowledge brain. I didn't use any finance figures, so no approval was needed.
